mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MEMBERS (EMAIL , NAME , NICKNAME , PASSWORD , REGIST_DATE , SALT) VALUES (#{email} , #{name} , #{nickname} , #{password} , SYSDATE , #{salt})
mapper.select: SELECT EMAIL , NAME , NICKNAME , PASSWORD , REGIST_DATE , MODIFY_DATE , LATEST_LOGIN_SUCCESS_DATE , LATEST_LOGIN_FAIL_DATE , LATEST_LOGOUT_DATE , LOGIN_FAIL_COUNT , LOGIN_BLOCK_YN , LOGIN_BLOCK_DATE , LOGIN_YN , SALT , DEL_YN FROM MEMBERS WHERE EMAIL = #{_parameter}
mapper.update: UPDATE MEMBERS SET LATEST_LOGIN_SUCCESS_DATE = SYSDATE , LOGIN_FAIL_COUNT = 0 , LOGIN_BLOCK_YN = 'N' , LOGIN_BLOCK_DATE = NULL , LOGIN_YN = 'Y' WHERE EMAIL = #{_parameter}
UPDATE MEMBERS SET LATEST_LOGIN_FAIL_DATE = SYSDATE , LOGIN_FAIL_COUNT = LOGIN_FAIL_COUNT + 1 WHERE EMAIL = #{_parameter}
UPDATE MEMBERS SET LOGIN_BLOCK_DATE = SYSDATE , LOGIN_BLOCK_YN = 'Y' WHERE EMAIL = #{_parameter} AND LOGIN_FAIL_COUNT >= 5
UPDATE MEMBERS SET LOGIN_BLOCK_DATE = NULL , LOGIN_BLOCK_YN = 'N' , LOGIN_FAIL_COUNT = 0 WHERE EMAIL = #{_parameter}
UPDATE MEMBERS SET LOGIN_YN = 'N' , LATEST_LOGOUT_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE EMAIL = #{_parameter}
UPDATE MEMBERS SET DEL_YN = 'Y' , PASSWORD = 'EXPIRED_USER' , SALT = 'EXPIRED_SALT' WHERE EMAIL = #{_parameter}
